set.approach: The climbing at Fairy Meadows is a scattering of short bolted routes, mostly on boulders, and they are easy to find by wandering among them. The Penguin is on an obvious boulder at the west end of the meadow and follows an arete.

review.notes: Area page: bolted boulder routes found by wandering; route page: obvious boulder at the west end of the meadow, arete. Area is spelled Fairly in the catalog; the meadow is Fairy. No access route stated for the meadow itself.
